candidates.change_summary: Change the required incoming value from 10 ether to 11 ether, altering when fallback updates state and potentially when funds are returned.
Remove the timestamp ordering check so fallback will always update pastBlockTime and possibly transfer on calls that send 10 ether regardless of timestamp.
Update pastBlockTime after the conditional transfer, so a transfer might occur before pastBlockTime changes.
Change the modulo divisor from 15 to 16, altering which blocks trigger the transfer and thus the contract's final balance and observable behavior.
Replace transfer of entire contract balance with sending only msg.value back to sender, changing resulting balance and observable behavior.
Insert an extra update setting pastBlockTime to block.timestamp + 1, changing the stored value after fallback and thus observable state.
Delete the line that updates pastBlockTime so the previous timestamp remains; this changes the persisted state after calls.
